name: OutnumbereD
source:
You've literally reached a Dead end, find out what lead you here and if this really is, the only outcome of your actions.

OutnumbereD is an Adult VN that follows "Grizz"  in his path of revenge.

Find out why he decides to do so and how it all eventually ends.

[From [url=https://tataugas.itch.io/outnumbered]Itch.io[/url]]

你实际上已经到达了一个死胡同，找出是什么导致你来到这里，如果这确实是你行动的唯一结果。
